list_item.paragraph: Role names and class arguments are converted to conform to the regular expression [a-z][-a-z0-9]* (letters are downcased, accents and similar decoration is stripped, non-conforming characters are replaced by a hyphen).
Class arguments may contain numbers and hyphens, which need special treatment in LaTeX command names.
Text with role "custom4" (but without styling by DUrole* macros).
With LaTeX, roles can be styled within the document using the raw directive.
inline text in large, bold, small-caps.
